sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 600. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 70 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: yourself. Applies Dawn for 120 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
Only [Humanity's Strongest] Mikasa & Levi can be used as Unlocking Potential material
